results.title: KTR appears before court in Formula E-car race case
results.description: Hyderabad, July 31 (IANS) Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) working president K.T. Rama Rao on Friday appeared before the special ACB Court here in the Formula E-car race case. Rama Rao and other accused in the case personally appeared in the court in response to the summons issued in May. Indian Administrative Service officer Arvind Kumar ...
